# mg37-multiplatform-sln

Original synthetic code written for this repository. It contains no third-party code or assets and is released under the repository license.

## Purpose

An old MonoGame 3.7 solution with a shared project (`.shproj` and `.projitems`), a Windows DirectX desktop project that imports the shared items, and Android, iOS and UWP platform projects. The UWP project has a `Content.mgcb` whose platform is `WindowsStoreApp`. It is never built.

## Positive for

MG012, MG013, MG014, MG024.
